title: Epic Games Achievement Weekly Time to Unlock Trend
dataSources: Video-game sessions (`game:session`), achievement unlocks (`achievement:unlock`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), chess games (`chess:game`), dice rolls (`dice:roll`).
app: Gaming and tabletop telemetry — Steam / PSN / Xbox playtime and achievement APIs, BoardGameGeek plays export, Lichess / Chess.com game archives, and tabletop dice-roller logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=epic:achievement unlock_time_min=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(unlock_time_min) as avg_duration, max(unlock_time_min) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst time to unlock for Epic Games achievement events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture unlock_time_min on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average time to unlock with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It finds whether Epic Games achievement tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
